name: dexio
description: A wiki your agents keep. Connects Dexio's hosted wiki over MCP, where agents read, search and edit linked pages with per-change history and broken-link checks, and adds twelve skills for keeping an LLM wiki correct: setup, orient, capture, record, ingest, query, lint, verify, review, conflicts, refactor and shared wikis. The skills also work on a local folder of markdown.
